name: DOOM Native Port
description: id Software's original DOOM source running natively on the PS5, with the shareware episode. Add your own DOOM, DOOM II and Final DOOM files from a PC or phone browser, a link or FTP.
author: lowbit
release_notes:
Sending games from a PC or phone now keeps full speed with large archives, and going back during a transfer no longer freezes the screen.

What's new
- Large files at full speed. A big archive used to slow down the longer it ran: the 643 MB DOOM + DOOM II collection 7Z fell to 0.4 MB/s past 400 MB and took over ten minutes. It now arrives at the network's speed the whole way, about a minute on a wired PS5, and its games are added a few seconds later.
- Circle stops a transfer at once. Going back while a file was arriving froze the screen until the file was done. It now stops right away and removes the partial file.
- No stalls in the browser. Browsers open spare connections, and the console waited on a quiet one for up to 30 seconds before answering anything else. It now answers whichever connection asks first, and replies no longer wait on Windows' delayed acknowledgements.

Install
- Download PPSA99666.zip and check it against PPSA99666.zip.sha256.
- Extract it and copy the PPSA99666 folder to /data/homebrew/ (FTP, ps5upload or USB). Copying over an earlier version keeps your games, saves and settings.
- ShadowMountPlus registers it within a few seconds and DOOM appears on the home screen.

Needs a jailbroken PS5 with kstuff and ShadowMountPlus. Tested on firmware 13.00.

The package contains no commercial game data. See the README for controls and licenses/ in the package for the third-party notices.
